candidates.tagline: $500 toothbrush with a camera that regular toothpaste blinds
candidates.story: Dyson launched a $499 AI toothbrush with a built-in camera that requires special non-foaming toothpaste because regular foam blinds the lens — then units immediately stopped working, prompting a stealth recall Dyson refuses to call a recall.
candidates.why_funny: A vacuum-company toothbrush needs its own custom toothpaste recipe to avoid blinding its own camera, then breaks anyway.
candidates.alt: Dyson CameraJet electric toothbrush in ceramic pink, a sleek high-tech device with a built-in camera in the handle

candidates.tagline: McLaren's new logo is giving Marriott Bonvoy
candidates.story: In September 2026, McLaren unveiled a new logo meant to honor its founder's 1920s garage sign — but the internet said it looks more like a hotel loyalty program than an F1 racing team.
candidates.why_funny: A legendary race team traded their aggressive identity for a wordmark that makes people ask if they can use their points for a free night.
candidates.alt: Side-by-side comparison of McLaren's old racing logo and the bland new 2026 wordmark redesign
